# orion card

Work items on the canvas

```sh
orion card <command> [options]
```

## orion card list

List work items with their derived status

```sh
orion card list [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                  |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `--group <value>` | Only items inside this group |
| `--all`           | Include done items           |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                   |

## orion card create

Add a work item

```sh
orion card create [options] [label...]
```

| Argument           | Description                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[label...]`       | What the work is                                                                                                                                      |
| `--group <value>`  | Group to add it to                                                                                                                                    |
| `--after <value>`  | Item the card follows; it lands beside it, in its group                                                                                               |
| `--before <value>` | Item the card leads into; it lands beside it, in its group                                                                                            |
| `--status <value>` | todo, active, review, blocked, deferred, or done                                                                                                      |
| `--repo <value>`   | Repository it belongs to, as owner/name (empty to clear)                                                                                              |
| `--who <value>`    | Whose move: you, review, or ci (empty to clear)                                                                                                       |
| `--note <value>`   | Free-form note (empty to clear)                                                                                                                       |
| `--shape <value>`  | How a component is drawn: service, store, actor, external, interface, process, or queue (empty to clear)                                              |
| `--color <value>`  | A component's tint: teal, blue, purple, amber, rose, green, or slate (empty to clear)                                                                 |
| `--kind <value>`   | step; gate for one that's done once everything it waits on is; or component for a part of a system, not work. A note given a kind becomes a work item |
| `--ref <value>`    | Attach outside work: a GitHub or Jira URL, source:key such as jira:ABC-1, or branch:owner/name@branch                                                 |
| `--json`           | Print JSON                                                                                                                                            |

## orion card set

Change an item's fields

```sh
orion card set [id] [options]
```

| Argument           | Description                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`             | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86                                                             |
| `--label <value>`  | New label                                                                                                                                             |
| `--status <value>` | todo, active, review, blocked, deferred, or done                                                                                                      |
| `--repo <value>`   | Repository it belongs to, as owner/name (empty to clear)                                                                                              |
| `--who <value>`    | Whose move: you, review, or ci (empty to clear)                                                                                                       |
| `--note <value>`   | Free-form note (empty to clear)                                                                                                                       |
| `--shape <value>`  | How a component is drawn: service, store, actor, external, interface, process, or queue (empty to clear)                                              |
| `--color <value>`  | A component's tint: teal, blue, purple, amber, rose, green, or slate (empty to clear)                                                                 |
| `--kind <value>`   | step; gate for one that's done once everything it waits on is; or component for a part of a system, not work. A note given a kind becomes a work item |
| `--field <value>`  | A field the card's types declare, as name=value, such as stage=final (empty value to clear)                                                           |
| `--ref <value>`    | Attach outside work: a GitHub or Jira URL, source:key such as jira:ABC-1, or branch:owner/name@branch                                                 |
| `--json`           | Print JSON                                                                                                                                            |

## orion card timeline

Show a card's timeline: its most recent log entries, newest first

```sh
orion card timeline [id] [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                                 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`            | Card id                                     |
| `--limit <value>` | How many recent entries to show (default 5) |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                                  |

## orion card done

Mark one or more items done

```sh
orion card done [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument                | Description                                          |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `[ids...]`              | Item ids or selectors                                |
| `--where <value>`       | Select targets with an expression instead of ids     |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview changes and current revision without writing |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision         |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                           |

## orion card chain-close

Close out a done card and the waiting done cards chained to it, so their Done stamps show

```sh
orion card chain-close [id] [options]
```

| Argument                | Description                                                                               |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`                  | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86 |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview the chain and current revision without writing                                    |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision                                              |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                                                                |

## orion card import

Add a card for each URL or source:key in one step

```sh
orion card import [options] [refs...]
```

| Argument                | Description                                           |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `[refs...]`             | GitHub or Jira URLs, or source:key such as jira:ABC-1 |
| `--stdin`               | Also read one reference per line from stdin           |
| `--group <value>`       | Group to add the cards to                             |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview the cards without writing                     |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision          |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                            |

## orion card snooze

Hide items from attention and orion next until a time

```sh
orion card snooze [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument                | Description                                                                                                |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[ids...]`              | Item ids                                                                                                   |
| `--until <value>`       | **Required.** When it wakes: an ISO 8601 date or date-time, in local time unless it ends in Z or an offset |
| `--where <value>`       | Select items with an expression instead of ids                                                             |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview changes and current revision without writing                                                       |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision                                                               |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                                                                                 |

## orion card unsnooze

Show snoozed items again right away

```sh
orion card unsnooze [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument                | Description                                          |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `[ids...]`              | Item ids                                             |
| `--where <value>`       | Select items with an expression instead of ids       |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview changes and current revision without writing |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision         |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                           |
